# Mimikit

> Lightweight single-session AI orchestration runtime in TypeScript, with manager/worker orchestration, WebUI, SSE, and local state files.

## Project

- Name: Mimikit
- Repo: https://github.com/phonowell/mimikit
- Language: TypeScript (ESM, strict)
- License: MIT
- Primary audience: developers building controllable local AI orchestration runtimes

## Quickstart

```bash
git clone https://github.com/phonowell/mimikit.git
cd mimikit
pnpm i
OPENAI_API_KEY=your_key pnpm start
```

## Entry Points

- CLI: `src/cli/index.ts`
- Orchestrator: `src/orchestrator/`
- Manager: `src/manager/`
- Worker: `src/worker/`
- HTTP + WebUI: `src/http/` and `webui/`
- Workflow docs: `docs/design/workflow/`

## Core Capabilities

- Single-session manager/worker orchestration (execution delegated to external runtimes)
- Structured plan triggers (`cron`, `scheduled_at`, `on_worker_slot_freed`)
- SSE event stream for UI sync
- File-backed runtime state (`history`, `tasks`, `results`, `runtime-snapshot`)
- Optional QQ webhook and passive reply pipeline
